name: How can I prevent future stucco damage after repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future stucco damage after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future stucco damage, ensure proper drainage away from your foundation, regularly inspect and maintain gutters and downspouts, and promptly address any leaks from roofs or windows. Avoid using harsh chemicals for cleaning that can degrade stucco. Regular inspections can help catch minor issues early before they escalate into major repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent stucco damage by ensuring proper drainage, maintaining gutters, fixing leaks promptly, and avoiding harsh cleaning chemicals.
